Spellbook 0.4.2 – DesignCraft Hungarian compatibility changes, 2026-10-22.
Copyright and MPL-2.0 notices of the original authors are retained in LICENSE and source.
Provenance and per-source checksums: sources.json.

Runtime changes:
- Signed compound syllable accounting avoids overflow/underflow for negative modifiers.
- Licensed suffix chains and final COMPOUNDRULE suffixes, including numeric compounds.
- Terminal suffix forbidden-flag behavior, homonyms and full-word bans.
- Compound-aware correction candidates, bounded by the existing word/suggestion limits.
- Ngram prefix/suffix expansion retains the suffix and applies prefix stripping to the
  same derived stem that passed its strip and condition checks (including a panic regression).
- Alternating three-affix chains check the middle affix condition on its restored stem.
  Positive and negative synthetic cases for both directions agree with native Hunspell 1.7.5.
- SIMPLIFIEDTRIPLE compares the two preceding codepoints before restoring a third.
  ASCII and multibyte positive/negative synthetic cases protect the guard.
Some upstream source formatting differs due to the parent project's rustfmt settings.

Vendoring:
Only src/, LICENSE, README.md, Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, this notice, sources.json and our
tests/hungarian_compatibility.rs are distributed. This revision includes the reviewed
ngram fix after the manually tested application. Upstream standalone examples, benchmarks,
legacy fixtures and full English/French dictionaries are omitted.
The upstream English unit-test fixture has a separate GPL license and is not
part of this distribution. Upstream fixture-dependent lib/doctests are disabled
in this minimal manifest, rather than silently replacing their data. Upstream
test modules remain in the preserved source but are not the default test target.
The independent integration suite includes eight synthetic regressions, 550
recorded Hunspell verdicts and ten expected Hungarian suggestions.
Run: cargo test --manifest-path vendor/spellbook/Cargo.toml --test hungarian_compatibility
This target is explicitly invoked by cargo xtask ci.
No C/C++ spellchecking library is linked into DesignCraft.
